alt: 窗外從春花、夏葉換成冬雪，屋裡的人卻始終用相同方式製作同一種小屋模型，桌椅、工具與成品都沒有改變。
scene_prompt: 一成不變 means something stays exactly the same over time and is never changed. ONE continuous modern home scene showing an adult's hobby corner remaining unchanged through different seasons: use three softly separated views of the SAME room from exactly the SAME angle, same adult with same plain gray cardigan in each, doing the identical routine of building the same simple square wooden house model. The identical table, chair, house model and tidy tools stay in exactly the same positions across all three views. Through the SAME window show spring cherry blossoms in the left view, summer green leaves and warm sun in middle, winter bare branch with snow in right. The changing seasons contrast clearly with the person's unchanged method and identical model; no implication that house is improving or unfinished construction progresses. Adult's expression mildly rigid, accustomed, not excited. No calendars, written dates, clocks with digits, labels, text, arrows, numbers or bubbles. Natural anatomically correct arms/hands, stable chair/table and models, delicate pencil soft watercolor paper.
